LanguageData.DeltaV_Tutorial_Description: You have reached your destination. Earlier colonists built this orbital station and sent a representative to welcome you. Your next task is learning to live, maintain equipment and pilot ships in space. Select a colonist or station building and use “Induction” to reopen the current briefing.
LanguageData.DeltaV_Tutorial_Stage_AwaitingWake: Preparing to open the cryptosleep casket.
LanguageData.DeltaV_Tutorial_Stage_Briefing: Bring your awakened colonist to the central dining table, then open “Induction” to report in.
LanguageData.DeltaV_Tutorial_Stage_ReadyForTraining: Arrival registration is complete. The living quarters and supplies are available. Arrange rest, meals and work for your colonist. Further lessons have not begun.
LanguageData.DeltaV_Tutorial_Dialog_Welcome:
Awake? Take your time getting up. Nausea after cryptosleep is normal.

Yes, this is the planet you set out for. We arrived a little earlier and have already built the station.

The surface is a dreadful place to settle: insects, mechanoids, aggressive pig people, Horax cultists and those dark archotechs. We tried it. Life in orbit suits us better. You are welcome to stay.
LanguageData.DeltaV_Tutorial_Dialog_Briefing:
A bed, oxygen and your first rations are ready. Take care of yourself, then come to the central table to report in.

You came here as a colonist, and everyone contributes. Flying, maintaining and designing ships will all be part of life here. Training will cover foundations and thrusters, weapons and shields, then salvage.

Select your colonist or a station building and open “Induction” whenever you need to hear the briefing again.
LanguageData.DeltaV_Tutorial_Dialog_ReadyForTraining: You are registered.\n\nThese quarters and the supplies beside the table are yours to use. Arrange meals, rest and work first. Nobody needs to start a shift immediately after waking from cryptosleep.
LanguageData.DeltaV_Tutorial_Leave: End induction and make my own arrangements.
LanguageData.DeltaV_Tutorial_OpenDesc: Hear the current briefing again and review the next step.
LanguageData.DeltaV_Tutorial_Targets: View the briefing point and colonist
LanguageData.DeltaV_Tutorial_ComeToBriefing: Bring a colonist who can move to the central dining table first.
LanguageData.DeltaV_Tutorial_MissingArrival: The cryosleep area or starting-colonist data is missing. Induction cannot continue.
LanguageData.DeltaV_Tutorial_WakeFailed: Your colonist could not leave the casket. Induction has stopped; check the cryosleep area.
LanguageData.DeltaV_Tutorial_BriefingLost: The briefing point has been removed. Induction cannot continue.
